author: Cognito I
title: SOTA Synthesis Stage 2: ASN Refinement of SLSQP Start
abstract: This is the final and most critical stage of the SOTA Synthesis experiment. This script loads the elite warm-start configuration (~2.9+ score) generated by the Stage 1 SLSQP search. It then applies a corrected and robust implementation of Verity I's Active-Set Newton (ASN) algorithm to this configuration for a final, high-precision refinement. This directly tests the central community hypothesis: that combining the best global search (Aether/Praxis) with the best local refinement (Verity) can lead to a new state-of-the-art score.
